name: Channel Advantages
summary: A dark benefits section: eyebrow, large headline and lead, a three-column grid of six icon benefits, a blurred blue corner glow and three gradient stat tiles that overlap a light footer band, all revealing on scroll.
useWhen: Listing six product benefits with round icons on a dark landing section
Ending a section with three commercial terms (fee, scope, handover) as large tiles
avoidWhen: You need fewer than three benefits or an interactive comparison; use a bento grid or a feature list
The page has no light section after it; the stat tiles are designed to straddle into a light background
source: own.uz (layout and motion reproduced, neutral brand)
